summary: Isaiah compares the survivors to the few olives still hanging on a tree after its branches have been beaten.

senses.definition: An individual fruit of the olive tree, counted among the gleanings on its branches.

evidence.note: Two or three fruits remain at the very top, and four or five on the fruitful branches. The comparison names the tree as an olive.

evidence.locator: C01258, Targum Isa 17:6 and Palestinian Targum Deu 32:14
pp. 96–97, ǧarǧīr, with an example from spoken Palestinian Arabic

note: The Levantine Arabic term specifically describes a shriveled olive and may have entered the dialect through Aramaic. Isaiah describes the few fruits still on the branches without saying that they are shriveled.
